fix.item: Fixed Pinterest Pin creation failures caused by missing or invalid article image URLs.
Added the resolved article image URL to Pinterest share links using the media parameter.
Converted relative article image paths to absolute URLs before sharing.
Removed Joomla image metadata fragments from generated Pinterest image URLs.
Added fallback image detection using the full article image, intro image, social metadata image, or first article image.

change.item: Updated the plugin version metadata to 3.1.11.

fix.item: Improved article share URL generation with Joomla content route helper fallback support.
Fixed relative URL normalisation for Joomla sites installed in subdirectories.
Rejected non-http share targets during URL normalisation as a defensive hardening measure.

change.item: Moved the final wrapper rendering into a Joomla layout file for cleaner plugin maintenance.
Replaced social monogram SVGs with consistent path-based SVG icons.
Bumped manifest, language messages and Web Asset Manager cache versions to 3.1.10.

fix.item: Fixed the incorrect version number displayed in the plugin About tab.
Updated the Joomla 6.1 plugin service provider to remove deprecated dispatcher constructor injection.
Improved routed article URL generation for share links.

language.item: Updated English language strings for the About tab, installer messages, and version information.
Updated Turkish language strings for the About tab, installer messages, and version information.

change.item: Updated the minimum Joomla requirement to Joomla 6.1.0.
Updated the package metadata, manifest version, and Web Asset Manager asset version to 3.1.9.
Changed language loading to runtime loading for better plugin performance.

fix.item: Fixed Joomla Web Asset Manager URIs so the plugin CSS and JavaScript load correctly.
Restored the frontend button styling, sizing, and social icons.

addition.item: Kept Joomla update server and changelog metadata for the public update channel.
